purpose: Known-fixture synthesis-only probe; changed thinking, sampling and prompt. Not an end-to-end agent run or isolated comparison.
question: What do these sources establish about ClearAir readiness and coordination? Keep the report under 200 words.
system_prompt: Write a JSON analytic report from these source records. Preserve the exact scope of each statement, including summary and qualifications. Absence from a corpus is not proof of real-world absence. Do not infer organizational functions from invented speaker role labels. For fictional entities, propose testing coverage or transferring the workflow to qualified real data, never authenticating the fictional events.
